label: GPT-6.1 Sol
output:
Rick, I’m still really pissed about what happened with Gary, and “that’s business, sis, can’t win ’em all” made it worse. This isn’t about me losing a listing. It’s about you promising my time and setting my price without asking me.

You told Gary I’d list his house for 1% as a “family rate.” My listing side is 2.5%. I never offered him 1%, and you had no business offering it for me. I spent about six hours Saturday pulling comps, doing the walkthrough, and putting together a full listing packet, plus the drive from north Phoenix. That was my whole Saturday.

Gary can hire whoever he wants. I’m not really mad at him for choosing ListLite. I’m mad that you volunteered me for a deal I never agreed to, then brushed it off when I told you what it cost me.

And now, before we’ve even settled this, you’ve given Denise my cell so she can “pick my brain.” This happened with your softball friend two years ago, too. I let it go then, but I’m not doing that again. You get to look like the guy who can hook everybody up, and I’m the one doing the work for free.

I’m happy to help Mom, your kids, and actual family with advice. That’s different from you making commitments to friends and coworkers on my behalf.

So I need this to stop: no more handing out my number, quoting my commission, or offering my time without asking me first. Every time. Let me decide what I’m willing to take on and what I charge.

I’m not calling Denise. You gave her my number without checking, so you can explain that you got ahead of yourself and I’m not available for that conversation.

I love you, and yes, I’m still coming to Thanksgiving. But being your sister doesn’t make my work yours to give away.
